TITLE: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, May 18, 2026
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-19 00:12 UTC

KEY:
1. Russian forces conducted LARGE-SCALE STRIKE against Ukraine overnight 17-18 May
   - 546 drones and missiles total — 14 Iskander-M ballistic / S-400; 8 Iskander-K cruise; 524 Shahed/Gerbera/Italmas/Parodiya
   - Launched from Bryansk, Kursk, Oryol cities; Millerovo Rostov Oblast; Primorsko-Akhtarsk Krasnodar Krai; occupied Donetsk City; occupied Hvardiiske Crimea
   - 4 Iskander-K + 503 drones downed
   - 18 missiles + 16 drones struck 34 locations; debris fell on 11
   - Primary target: Dnipro City and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
   - Zelensky: civilian infrastructure damaged; energy and residential infrastructure targeted
   - Also Odesa City — including Chinese-owned ship approaching port
   - Civilian/residential strikes in Chernihiv, Kharkiv, Kirovohrad, Kherson, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk oblasts
   - At least 33 civilians injured incl 3 children
   - Russia using more ballistic missiles to take advantage of Ukrainian air defence limits (global Patriot interceptor shortage)

2. UKRAINE'S NEW DOMESTICALLY-PRODUCED KAB GUIDED GLIDE BOMB
   - Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov May 18: ready for combat use
   - 250kg payload; tens of kilometres range from launch
   - Will allow Ukrainian forces to expand battlefield air interdiction (BAI) campaign vs Russian rear targets
   - Mirrors Russia's use of glide bombs against Ukrainian logistics

3. RUSSIAN ECONOMY UNDER STRAIN
   - Russian Minister of Economic Development Maxim Reshetnikov (RBK May 18): Russian government revised GDP growth expectations downward
   - Labour shortages + sanctions + Middle East war
   - Zelensky/SZRU intel (May 18): one unspecified Russian oil company alone closed 400 wells
   - Russia reduced oil refining by at least 10% in 2026
   - 11 Russian financial institutions preparing to LIQUIDATE
   - 8 more banking institutions cannot resolve problems internally
   - Russia's federal budget deficit already almost $80 BILLION in first 5 months of 2026
   - Russia depleted sovereign wealth fund liquid reserves; selling physical gold reserves

4. STATE DUMA DEFENCE CMTE - POSSIBLE LAPIN REPLACEMENT FOR KARTAPOLOV
   - Kommersant May 14: United Russia considering Col Gen Alexander Lapin
   - Kartapolov is close to Shoigu; ongoing campaign by Putin to remove Shoigu-aligned personnel
   - Lapin has poor battlefield record — consistent with Putin's pattern of rotating poor performers

5. BELARUS NUCLEAR EXERCISES
   - Belarusian MoD May 18: Russian and Belarusian forces began joint exercise on use of nuclear weapons
   - Including practicing delivering nuclear munitions and preparing for combat use

GROUND OPS:
- Ukrainian forces advanced in Oleksandrivka direction
- Russian forces FAILED to recapture Spring 2026 Ukrainian counterattack gains in Oleksandrivka
- Ukrainian Caspian Sea strikes continued — Project 21980 Grachonok anti-sabotage boat hit
- Ukraine GUR geolocated footage confirms Ukrainian forces maintain presence in central Stepnohirsk + at M-18 Vasylivka-Kamyanske highway junction (Zaporizhzhia)
- Russian glide bomb "kill zone" extended to ~30km behind frontline (Kostyantynivka commander)
